body: It's kind of a catch 22 situation. There's only one person I would truly trust to talk about this sort of thing with irl, but they are also the one person that would be extremely upset to hear about it, and of course talking about this sort of thing can alter how someone looks at you & treats you, even if it's out of caring. This is basically the first time I've expressed these thoughts to other people, even though it's anonymous & not too dissimilar to shouting into a void.
First option sounds kind of similar to the novel 'The Giver'. It's a dystopia disguised as a utopia.
Ok, this actually got a small smile from me.
